description: This file declares the CmadHandler class, which inherits from CmadLogger and manages CMA (likely Connection Management or Configuration Management) data, including building, comparing, and logging CMA nodes. It also handles file naming and memory management related to CMA data.

classes.name: CmadHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing CMA data, extending logging capabilities, building CMA node lists, comparing CMA sets, logging information, and handling file naming and memory management.

methods.name: CmadHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a buffer length and optional filename postfix and extension.

methods.name: ~CmadHandler()
methods.description: Destructor that logs its invocation and deletes the internal CMA data pointer.

methods.name: SetFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename using a given postfix and extension.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of CMA nodes from the provided CMA header list.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two lists of CMA nodes and identifies common elements.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs CMA data for a specified iteration.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Prints CMA data, enabled only if DEBUG_MLT_ENABLE is set.
